=== Chronology ===
* March, Ten'an 2 ({{ill|858|Q30371|qid=Q30371}}): became an official shrine
* June 23, J?gan 6 ({{ill|864|Q25041|qid=Q25041}}): Senior Fourth Rank, Lower in ''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}''
* November 4, J?gan 8 ({{ill|866|Q23872|qid=Q23872}}): Junior Third Rank in ''Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku''
* August, Bunky? 3 ({{ill|1863|Q7701|qid=Q7701}}): Tend?gumi forces placed their headquarters on this mountain
* Meiji 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}): ranked as G?-sha
